pages.text: Step through the portal ready for a fight — the Twilight Forest is the primary T2 adventure dimension, and its seven bosses hold the first Simply Swords uniques.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Twilight Forest is the most content-dense T2 dimension. Seven bosses with unique weapons, a full progression path through the forest, and some of the best T2 loot tables.$(br2)$(bold)Boss order:$() The forest has an internal progression. You cannot reach late zones without defeating earlier bosses. Follow the magic map for the intended order.

$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$() Twilight structure chests have had diamonds removed. Tokens and T2 materials replace them. The forest's original loot has been preserved otherwise — Steeleaf and Ironwood armor are valid T2 gear choices.$(br2)$(bold)Twilight materials:$() Steeleaf, Ironwood, Fiery, Knightmetal are all valid T2 gear materials.

$(bold)No guide book.$() Twilight Forest is largely self-guided — each biome leads naturally to the next boss. Craft the $(bold)Magic Map$() (recipe in JEI) to reveal the dimension layout and boss locations.$(br2)$(bold)Next: the Naga's courtyard — the forest's intended first fight: $(l:icraft:bosses/t2_bosses)Tier 2 Bosses$(/l).$()
